lines.rom: jaya jaya jaharavira hare jaya jaya guga vira hare dharati para a karake bhaktom ke dukha dura kare
jo koi bhakti kare prema se ham ji kare prema se bhage dukha pare vighana hare mamgala ke data tana ka kasta hare
jevara rava ke putra kahaye rani bachala mata bagara janma liya vira ne jaya jayakara kare
dharma ki bela barhai nisa dina tapasya roja kare dusta janom ko danda diya jaga mem rahe apa khare
